levels.surface: أبوإسحاق إبراهيم بن محمد بن حمزة بن عمارة الحافظ

notes: «فيما كتب إلي» is the mode of transmission (by writing), not a link; «الحافظ» is kept as written
«قال أبوعروبة: عن مياثر الحمر» is a wording variant of the saying: left out (rule 4)
The Imam Husayn is named inside the chain after «عن», so he is a narrator; the saying is his report of the Prophet's nine prohibitions
